newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates close low.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates close low.

text.p: Overnight call rates in Pakistan's interbank money market dropped on Wednesday on an inflow of funds, dealers said.
"Unexpectedly, overnight call money rates dropped to 5.00 percent in the last hour of trading," one dealer said.
Most deals were done at 16.95 percent in the morning but suddenly rates slipped to 8.00 percent owing to major inflows of funds in the banking system, the dealer said.
The market closed in surplus. "It is expected that rates will stay soft tomorrow," he said.
